title: Madras High Court Grants Dynamic Anti-Piracy Injunction for Vijay Deverakonda's 'Ranabaali' Ahead of Release
case_name: Mythri Movie Makers v. Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited & Ors.
citation: O.A. Nos. 1144 to 1147 of 2026 in C.S.(Comm Div) No. 288 of 2026; 2026 LLBiz HC(MAD) 321
card_summary: Justice P.B. Balaji granted producer Mythri Movie Makers an interim John Doe injunction restraining unauthorised recording and distribution of its Vijay Deverakonda starrer 'Ranabaali' ahead of release. The order binds telecom operators, ISPs and platforms such as X Corp, YouTube and Meta, on a prima facie case for pre-emptive protection against piracy. Notice issued, returnable 11 November 2026.
card_tip: Producers should apply for a John Doe/Ashok Kumar blocking order naming ISPs and platforms before release, not after a leak surfaces, since courts will act on apprehended piracy where a prima facie case is shown.
verification_notes: Decision date (15 October 2026), judge, and respondent list are consistent across LiveLawBiz and Lawbhoomi. The film's title is spelled both 'Ranabaali' and 'Ranaballi' across sources; both spellings are used here only where a source used them. A separate Bengaluru court order on defamatory content about the same film is a different proceeding and is not reported here.
